name: Agua de Monfortinho
verdict: Belongs to Portuguese entrepreneur Ricardo Leitao Machado (AEnergy founder, owner of Herdade do Vale Feitoso), who bought the Termas de Monfortinho in March 2025. Nothing found.
note: Bottled-water brand from the Termas de Monfortinho (Idanha-a-Nova); shorts sponsor at Alverca in 2026-27.
